summary: 40 proposals judged: 33 PASS, 7 FAIL (82.5%). The cuts held up well (24 of 26), and the two that failed share a habit: the reader cut because the target page was silent, even though the source states a reason (Differential Equations on difference equations; Categorizing Inharmonicity on invisible signal flow, which the compressor echoes). The retypes are where the room overreached. It used exemplifies for every page that hosts a Philosopher Visit (Mathieu, LPC, Torus), but a page that is visited is not an instance of the mode. It also called Compressor Design an instance of the ratio-as-slope pattern, a reframing the compressor page never makes. The one failed label (Shepard to Frequency-Time Duality) took the Risset rhythm's time-domain twinship and moved it onto the wrong page. No quotes were fabricated. Separately from the verdicts, four whys invent reciprocal links that are not in the target's frontmatter, so any cut-the-reciprocal follow-up from this set should be checked before it runs.
